name: build_salvage_plan
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

all.description: Full workflow context (e.g. Conductor's ${workflow} binding) used to recover a publishable branch/repo/commit from a failed run's own state.

reason.description: Human-readable failure reason surfaced when no more specific reason is available.

workflowId.description: Failed workflow's ID, echoed into the plan.

failedWorkflow.description: The failed run's own workflow record.

variables.description: Failed workflow variables; currentBranch/currentWorkspacePath/candidateCommit are preferred over the workspace task output.

currentBranch.description: Branch recorded by the failed run.

currentWorkspacePath.description: Workspace/repo path recorded by the failed run.

candidateCommit.description: Candidate commit recorded by the failed run.

issueNumber.description: Issue number the failed run was working on, echoed into the plan (stringified).

base.description: Base branch the failed run targeted; defaults to 'main' when absent.

tasks.description: Failed workflow's task list; the first task named 'workspace' or 'clone' supplies a branch/repoPath fallback via its outputData.

referenceTaskName.description: Task reference name; 'workspace' or 'clone' is used as the fallback source.

outputData.description: That task's output, read for branch/repoPath/worktreePath/baseCommit.

branch.description: Recovered branch name to publish, preferring the failed run's variables over the workspace task output.

issueNumber.description: Issue number from the failed run's input, stringified (empty string when absent).

base.description: Base branch from the failed run's input, defaulting to 'main'.

canPublish.description: String boolean (consumed by a value-param SWITCH) indicating whether both branch and repoPath were recovered.

reason.description: Failure reason, from the workflow context or a default explanation.

workflowId.description: The failed workflow's ID, or empty string.
